title: What Your Blood Pressure Should Be by Age (35–65+)
primaryKeyword: what should my blood pressure be by age
description: Blood pressure targets change with age—130/80 is now high for adults 40+. Learn your ideal numbers and when to act, based on AHA/ACC 2023 guidelines.
reasoning: People are searching 'bp care' because they’re confused by shifting guidelines and age-specific thresholds—especially after recent AHA updates and viral social posts about 'normal' BP at 45 vs. 60. They want clear, actionable, age-tailored benchmarks—not clinical jargon—and reassurance on when to worry or seek help.
